recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not reintroduce statusReason for this STU3 issue; any future wording work should be handled through the current adherence.reason model and its related issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-14832 requested correcting MedicationStatement.statusReason from misleading not-given wording to a status-reason short, definition, and comment distinguishing status reason from reasonCode.
initial_application: The Jira comment and git-svn commit e4206a3abafba1275c89a32c29f2715a17e0e0e7 show the requested wording applied to medicationstatement-spreadsheet.xml on Feb. 16, 2018; later StructureDefinition history still carried that applied wording.
additional_context: MedicationStatement remains active and approved in source/fhir.ini, but later Pharmacy decisions moved statusReason semantics into the adherence backbone. FHIR-31950 is already audited on the combined branch, FHIR-38682 restored the MedicationStatement name, and FHIR-32858 clarified the current adherence.reason text.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source has no active MedicationStatement.statusReason element, and MedicationStatement.reason/adherence.reason already preserve the distinction between the reason for the statement and reasons for medication use, non-use, or adherence.

related_jiras.note: Moved MedicationUsage.statusReason to adherence.reason and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 72d020b5bc49ded7e3664bb1da2b4275e43b3a79.
Renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement while retaining the status/adherence changes that superseded statusReason.
Confirmed the status/adherence/effective model and is already represented on the combined branch by commit d23bc1561f2919b1feeaad8baae92334beb40992.
